title: C482/1207/2010 of CHANDAN SINGH MANRAL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and ANOTHER

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Criminal Misc. Application No. 1207 of 2010
(Under Section 482 Cr.P.C.)
Chandan Singh Manral .......... Applicant
versus
State of Uttarakhand and Another .......... Respondents
Mr. A.M. Saklani, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Prem Kaushal, Brief Holder for the State.
None is present on behalf of the respondent no.3.
U. C. Dhyani, J. (Oral)
 By means of present application under Section 482
Cr.P.C., applicant seeks to quash the order dated 07.12.2010, under
Sections 145(1) & 146(1) of Cr.P.C., passed by Sub-Divisional
Magistrate, Ramnagar, District-Nainital in Criminal Case No.9/3 of
2010 (Sapan Adhikari vs. Radha & others), pending in the Court of
Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Ramnagar, District-Nainital.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the sole-respondent has died. Proceedings were initiated against the applicant
under Sections 145(1) & 146(1) of Cr.P.C. When the other side has
died, therefore, it appears that proceedings under Sections 145(1) &
146(1) of Cr.P.C. have rendered infructuous.

3. At the time of admission of present C-482 petition, this
Court passed an interim order, vide order dated 20.12.2010, and stayed
the criminal case initiated against applicant under Sections 145(1) &
146(1) of Cr.P.C., pending in the Court of Sub-Divisional Magistrate,
Ramnagar, District-Nainital, till the next date of listing.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the
criminal proceedings initiated against the applicant are nothing but
abuse of process of the Court and the interim order should be made
absolute.

-2-
5. It will be a futile exercise to keep present petition under
Section C-482 Cr.P.C. pending in this Court, when the complainant has
died.
6. The petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is, therefore,
allowed. The order dated 07.12.2010, under Sections 145 (1) & 146(1)
of Cr.P.C., passed by Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Ramnagar, District-Nainital in Criminal Case No.9/3 of 2010, pending in the Court Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Ramnagar, District-Nainital, are hereby quashed,
qua applicant only.
7. Liberty is granted to the legal representatives of
respondent no.3, to move for recall of this order, if they feel aggrieved
with the same.
 (U. C. Dhyani, J.)
 07.07.2017
A.kaur
